rows.en: －　Maintenance Room　－
＊Sakaki＊＠１５４＿０２７Eek!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿００１Oh, you startled me...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿００２Someone's still here?￥At this hour, I thought￥everyone was gone.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿００３It's good that you're eager, but￥maybe you shouldn't stay here￥too long.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿００４Being eager is fine, but a girl￥probably shouldn't stay here￥this late.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿００５There are strange rumors, too...
What strange rumors?
Okay, I'll head back.
What kind of rumors?
All right, I'll go back.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿００６Nothing serious, just a little￥ghost story about this room.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿００７Yes, do that.＝＠１５１＿００８Wandering around the facility￥this late...＝＠１５１＿００９If there's an accident, we can't￥take responsibility for it.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０１０You need to act with more￥awareness as a candidate.＝＠１５１＿０１１I'm closing this area, so￥please leave now.

＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０１２Long ago, this Maintenance Room￥had a big press machine that￥got a lot of use.＝＠１５１＿０１３One day, a veteran mechanic was￥checking the press, when an￥accident happened.＝＠１５１＿０１４Just as he leaned in to look...￥the press went off by mistake.＝＠１５１＿０１５His head got caught, and￥they say he died instantly...＝＠１５１＿０１６The press was scrapped, but￥ever since then...＝＠１５１＿０１７they say a headless ghost￥haunts this facility.
Is that story true?
Ghosts aren't real.
Is that story true?
Ghosts aren't real.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０１８I've never seen it myself,￥so I couldn't say.＝＠１５１＿０１９I do think it's just a￥rumor, though...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２０But even knowing that,￥walking alone after lights-out￥is a little...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２１Yes, I think so too, but...￥once you know the story,￥it's still a little...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２２Well, it's about time￥to close up!＝＠１５１＿０２３If you still need something￥here, I can wait a bit longer.
No, I was just leaving.
I only stopped by.
No, I was just leaving.
I only stopped by.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２４I see.￥Then shall we walk back￥together partway?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２５Everyone's working hard￥in training.＝＠１５１＿０２６I can see why you wouldn't￥want to fall behind.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２７Oh, is that so?
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２８Then what were you doing￥in here until now?
I was training.
Just goofing off a bit.
I was training.
Just taking a walk...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５１＿０２９You're working hard too.＝＠１５１＿０３０I know you don't want to fall￥behind, but don't overdo it!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００１I'm a little disappointed...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００２I'm not telling you to push￥yourself, but you don't seem to￥take your candidacy seriously.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００３I'll keep doing my rounds.￥You hurry on back￥to your room.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００４Earlier, I ran into some￥candidates still training￥in other facilities.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００５It was past lights-out, so I￥sent them off, but they're all￥working so hard. Impressive!
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００６They're training right up￥to the very last minute.
I need to step it up...
Everyone's trying hard.
I need to step it up...
Everyone's working hard.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００７What are you saying?￥You're working hard this￥late yourself.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００８Working hard is good, but I￥don't want you overdoing it.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿００９It's true.￥But you're one of them, too.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０１０Working hard is good,￥but I don't want any of you￥overdoing it.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０１１If you candidates cooperated￥and trained together, you'd￥be even more efficient.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０１２I'll support you as much￥as I can.＝＠１５２＿０１３If anything in the facility￥isn't working right, tell me￥right away.＝＠１５２＿０１４Well, I'll keep patrolling,￥so I'll leave you here.
＊Sakaki＊...
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０１５To tell the truth,￥I was a little spooked by the￥Maintenance Room ghost.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０１６So I'm really glad you￥came along with me.
＊Sakaki＊＠１５２＿０１７Well, get plenty of rest￥tonight for tomorrow.
